parameters.query: SELECT l.fee_per_player, t.id AS tid, t.code, t.name AS tname, t.status, (t.registration_deadline < NOW()) AS closed, t.organizer_user_id, d.id AS did, d.name AS dname, d.squad_min, d.squad_max, d.max_teams, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entries e WHERE e.division_id = d.id AND e.status = 'APPROVED') AS approved, u.id AS uid, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entries e JOIN teams x ON x.id = e.team_id WHERE e.tournament_id = t.id AND LOWER(x.name) = LOWER($4) AND e.status NOT IN ('REJECTED', 'WITHDRAWN')) AS same_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teams x WHERE x.code = $5) AS code_taken FROM tournament_web_links l JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = l.tournament_id LEFT JOIN tournament_divisions d ON d.id = $2 AND d.tournament_id = t.id LEFT JOIN app_users u ON u.phone = $3 WHERE l.slug = $1
